description: T-3353: two-flow XIRR over long spans. Rows 1..270: A v0=-1000, B v1 = 1000*(1+r)^(days/365) to 6 significant digits, C 2000-01-01, D C + round(years*365.25) for years in [1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10, 15, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 75, 90, 100] (outer) and r in [-0.9, -0.5, -0.2, -0.05, -0.01, 0.001, 0.01, 0.03, 0.05, 0.08, 0.12, 0.2, 0.35, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10] (inner); E XIRR(A:B,C:D) (default guess), F the closed form (-B/A)^(365/(D-C))-1 in Excel's ^, G XNPV(E,A:B,C:D).
